verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents programmatic transcription jobs: batch job submit, status, cancel and list operations, plus completion webhooks. Nothing in the evidence describes saved automations or workflows that a user can version, review in a diff or history, or roll back. The batch job lifecycle and vocabulary asset create and delete endpoints are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
